text: dsh-figma-mcp 是 DSH Web 端的 Figma MCP 连接插件。它通过 OAuth 将 Figma MCP 服务接入 DSH，在设置页提供授权状态、登录、续期、断开和 Skill 开关，并注册 /dsh-figma-mcp 工作流命令。用户可让 Agent 借助 MCP 工具查看或处理 Figma 设计内容。适合需要在 DSH 对话中使用 Figma 设计信息的用户；使用前需要 Figma 账号并完成授权，连接凭据保存在本机 DSH 配置文件中。

dsh-figma-mcp connects Figma MCP to DSH Web with OAuth. Settings provide login, status, refresh, disconnect, and a Skill toggle; a slash command starts guided workflows. The agent can use Figma MCP tools. A Figma account is required, and credentials are stored in local DSH configuration.
我想在 DSH 对话里直接查看 Figma 设计稿。
怎么把 Figma 的 MCP 工具接到 DSH？
让 DSH 能读取我设计文件里的组件和变量。
Figma 授权过期了，能在 DSH 里续一下吗？
我需要把设计稿内容交给 Agent 处理，还想要一个固定流程入口。
Can I connect Figma MCP tools to my DSH chat?
I want to inspect design files and variables from my DSH workflow.
dsh-figma-mcp 的功能「连接 Figma」：在设置页发起 OAuth 登录并登记 Figma MCP 客户端，授权回调后把令牌配置到 DSH 的 MCP 服务项。用户点击连接或重新授权开始流程。
dsh-figma-mcp 的功能「查看连接并续期」：设置页显示连接状态和到期信息，并可请求刷新授权；刷新成功后更新本地配置。用户在连接设置中查看或点击刷新。
dsh-figma-mcp 的功能「固定工作流命令」：注册 /dsh-figma-mcp 命令，根据输入的工作流名称生成提示并交给当前 Agent。用户执行命令并可附加补充说明。
dsh-figma-mcp 的功能「管理内置 Skill」：设置页开关控制插件是否向 DSH 的技能提供器列出内置 Figma 操作指南。用户可在设置页启用或关闭该 Skill。
能不能从 DSH 里打开 Figma 连接设置并重新授权？

dsh-figma-mcp README · 简介：DSH 的 Figma MCP 一键连接插件，对话中粘贴链接，Agent 即可读写节点/图层/变量/样式，生成 React/Vue 代码，OAuth 安全登录，Token 本机存储，内置工作流指令和 Skill 引导使用。

dsh-figma-mcp README · 从 npm 安装：```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-figma-mcp
```

dsh-figma-mcp README · 从 GitHub 安装：```bash
dsh plugin add github:lubanqihao9875/dsh-figma-mcp
```

dsh-figma-mcp README · 本地开发：先克隆仓库并进入目录：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lubanqihao9875/dsh-figma-mcp.git
cd dsh-figma-mcp
```

再把当前目录链接到 DSH：

```bash
dsh-figma-mcp README · macOS / Linux：dsh plugin add link:$(pwd)

dsh-figma-mcp README · Windows（PowerShell）：dsh plugin add link:"$PWD"
```

安装后重启 DSH，「设置 → DSH Figma MCP」卡片出现，点「连接 Figma」完成授权即可。
dsh-figma-mcp README · 卡片：卡片分为两个组：「连接」（授权状态）和「Skill」（是否把 Figma MCP 用法注入到Agent skill 列表）

dsh-figma-mcp README · 连接：| 状态标签 | 含义 | 该做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 未连接 | 尚未授权 | 点「连接 Figma」弹出浏览器 |
| 已连接 | token 有效 | 什么都不用做 |
| 即将过期 | 剩余不足 24 小时 | 建议点「刷新授权」 |
| 已过期 | token 已失效 | 点「重新授权」 |

授权完成后卡片会自动从「未连接」切到「已连接」。
dsh-figma-mcp README · Skill：「Skill」开关控制是否把 `dsh-figma-mcp-skill` 注入 Agent 的技能列表， `dsh-figma-mcp-skill` 告诉 DSH 怎么选 `mcp__figma__*` 工具，默认开启。
dsh-figma-mcp README · 过期与刷新：token 有效期以 Figma 下发为准。临近过期状态标签会变成黄色「即将过期」。「刷新授权」是后台静默续期，不开浏览器；只有完全失效才需要「重新授权」重走一次浏览器流程。
dsh-figma-mcp README · 断开与卸载：「断开」只清本地：patch 文件里的 token 和刷新凭据立即删除。卸载插件前先点断开，否则 patch 文件里会残留一条仍然有效的 token。

dsh-figma-mcp README · 使用示例：连接成功后，在 DSH 对话里直接把 Figma 链接贴进 prompt，告诉 Agent 你想做什么，Agent 会自动调用 `mcp__figma__*` 工具读取内容并操作任务。也可以使用 `/dsh-figma-mcp <指令> [补充说明]` 开启固定工作流。缺少必要信息时，Agent 会交互式逐项提问，拿到回答后自动继续。涉及写入 Figma、下载资产或写入本地文件时，会先给出确认再操作。
dsh-figma-mcp README · 阅读设计稿内容：> 帮我看这个设计稿里有什么内容：你的 Figma 文件链接（如 `https://www.figma.com/design/<文件ID>`）
dsh-figma-mcp README · 提取文案做 i18n：> 从上面这个 Figma 文件里把所有按钮和标题文案抽出来，做成中英文 i18n 表
dsh-figma-mcp README · 基于设计稿生成代码：> 把上面这个 Figma 页面转成 React 代码

dsh-figma-mcp README · Overview：The one-click Figma MCP connector for DSH, paste a Figma link into chat, and the Agent can read/write nodes, layers, variables, and styles, generate React/Vue code, secure OAuth login, token stored locally, with built-in workflow commands and Skill to guide the way.

dsh-figma-mcp README · From npm：```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-figma-mcp
```

dsh-figma-mcp README · From GitHub：```bash
dsh plugin add github:lubanqihao9875/dsh-figma-mcp
```

dsh-figma-mcp README · Local development：Clone the repo and enter the directory first:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lubanqihao9875/dsh-figma-mcp.git
cd dsh-figma-mcp
```

Then link the current directory into DSH:

```bash
dsh-figma-mcp README · macOS / Linux：dsh plugin add link:$(pwd)

dsh-figma-mcp README · Windows (PowerShell)：dsh plugin add link:"$PWD"
```

After installing, restart DSH. The "Settings → DSH Figma MCP" card appears — click "Connect Figma" to complete the authorization.
dsh-figma-mcp README · Card：The card has two sections: "Connection" (authorization state) and "Skill" (whether the Figma MCP usage is injected into the Agent skill list)

dsh-figma-mcp README · Connection：| Status chip | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Not connected | Not yet authorized | Click "Connect Figma" to open the browser |
| Connected | Token is valid | Nothing to do |
| Expiring soon | Less than 24h left | Suggested: click "Refresh auth" |
| Expired | Token is no longer valid | Click "Reauthorize" |

After authorization the card switches from "Not connected" to "Connected" automatically.

dsh-figma-mcp README · Skill：The "Skill" toggle controls whether `dsh-figma-mcp-skill` is injected into the Agent's skill list. `dsh-figma-mcp-skill` tells DSH how to pick the `mcp__figma__*` tools. It is on by default.

dsh-figma-mcp README · Expiry and refresh：The token lifetime follows what Figma issues. As the token approaches expiry, the status chip turns yellow ("Expiring soon"). "Refresh auth" silently renews the token in the background without opening a browser; only when it is completely invalid do you need "Reauthorize" to go through the browser flow again.

dsh-figma-mcp README · Disconnect and uninstall："Disconnect" only clears local data: the token and refresh credentials in the patch file are deleted immediately. Click Disconnect before uninstalling the plugin, otherwise a still-valid token will remain in the patch file.

dsh-figma-mcp README · Usage examples：After connecting, paste a Figma link directly into a DSH chat and tell the Agent what you want. The Agent automatically calls the `mcp__figma__*` tools to read content and run the task.You can also start a fixed workflow with `/dsh-figma-mcp <command> [extra context]`. When required information is missing, the Agent asks for it interactively one field at a time and continues automatically after each answer. Actions that write to Figma, download assets, or write local files ask for confirmation first.
dsh-figma-mcp README · Read design content：> Show me what's in this design file: your Figma file URL (e.g. `https://www.figma.com/design/<file-id>`)
